title: Create a CPU Alarm & Notification
description: Design a CloudWatch alarm that triggers when EC2 CPU exceeds 80% and sends an email.
problemStatement:
You have a production EC2 instance that must never exceed 80% CPU utilisation for more than 5 minutes, otherwise the ops team needs to be alerted. Design the CloudWatch alarm configuration.

Include:
- The metric namespace and metric name.
- Statistic (Average, Sum, etc.) and period.
- Threshold condition and number of evaluation periods.
- The action to take when the alarm state is reached (service and resource needed).
- How to ensure the alarm can send an email to `ops@example.com`.

Write your answer as a step‑by‑step guide.
hints: For 'more than 5 minutes', a period of 1 minute with 5 evaluation periods works, or 5‑minute period with 1 out of 1 datapoints.
Alarm action: SNS topic with email subscription.
solutionCode:
1. In CloudWatch console, go to Alarms → Create Alarm.
2. Select metric: EC2 → Per‑Instance Metrics, choose `CPUUtilization` for the instance.
3. Statistic: Average, Period: 1 minute (if detailed monitoring enabled) or 5 minutes (basic). With basic, set period 5 min and evaluation periods 1 out of 1 (trigger immediately). For detailed, period 1 min, consecutive 5 periods.
4. Condition: Threshold type Static, `CPUUtilization` > 80.
5. Click Next.
6. Alarm state trigger: In ALARM state. Select an existing SNS topic or create new topic `EC2-CPU-Alerts`.
   - Create topic, enter email `ops@example.com`. After creation, check email and confirm subscription.
7. Click Next, give alarm name `HighCPU-alert`, Next, Create.

Now if CPU > 80% for the defined time, an email is sent to ops@example.com.
